title: parse_observe_option accepts 4-byte values but should be max 3 bytes
description:
File: rust/lichen-gateway/src/discovery.rs
Lines: 147-159

The function correctly rejects values > 3 bytes at line 151-152, but the comment at line 152 says 'max 3 bytes (24-bit)'. This is correct per RFC 7641 Section 3.4.

However, the check uses 'value.len() > 3' which rejects 4+ bytes. The edge case of exactly 3 bytes with value 0xFFFFFF is correctly handled.

Status: NOT A BUG - code is correct. Closing as verified-correct.
close_reason: Verified correct - not a bug. The check properly rejects 4+ byte values.
